messages.text:
Batch 5 ships November 30, 2026. At 405 W that's about $29 a month in power at 10¢/kWh, on top of the $899.

Are you weighing it against the Magic Miner 40T, or is this your first miner?

Depends where it's going. The B30 ships from our US/Canada side, so to the EU it's $899 plus 21% import VAT and any duty, charged by the carrier on delivery — we don't collect it at checkout. UK same idea. US and Canada: none, just sales tax where it applies.

Where would it ship?

So on a $899 B30: roughly $189 import VAT on delivery, plus any duty, paid to the carrier before they hand it over. Shipping is separate, calculated at checkout from your address.

Which country, and what do you pay per kWh? I'll run the sats and power cost for you.
